caption:
Adobe just signed its first tennis sponsorship anywhere in the world, and picked the Australian Open.

The software giant is now the AO's Official AI Marketing and Creativity Partner in a multi-year, phased deal. Tennis Australia will use Adobe's tools to personalise everything from which match you watch to where you eat at Melbourne Park, with year-round play across Australia and Asia-Pacific in the brief too.

Also today: Red Bull x MotoGP Australian GP, DoorDash x Australian Open, GAC x Chelsea, Expedia x NHL, IM8 x NBA, American Express x SailGP Hong Kong, Adyen x FC Bayern, Hasbro x The FA, Hardee's x 23XI Racing.
